name: universidadXYZ
description: Monorepo — Plataforma Académica Universidad Tecnológica XYZ

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -p "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "green,yellow,magenta,cyan" -n "STUDENTS,COURSES,GATEWAY,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --workspace=backend/student-service" "npm run dev --workspace=backend/course-service" "npm run dev:gateway:safe" "npm run dev:frontend:safe"
scripts.dev:gateway:safe: wait-on tcp:3001 tcp:3002 && npm run dev --workspace=backend/api-gateway
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -p "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "green,yellow,magenta" -n "STUDENTS,COURSES,GATEWAY" "npm run dev --workspace=backend/student-service" "npm run dev --workspace=backend/course-service" "npm run dev:gateway:safe"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend/student-service && npm run test --workspace=backend/course-service
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=backend/student-service && npm run test:unit --workspace=backend/course-service
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
